profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at GridPoint
profile.summary:
I'm a remote backend web developer working mainly in Elixir. I love to write clear, maintainable code. I also enjoy teaching programming concepts via my conference talks and writing.

My conference talks include:

- "String Theory" at ElixirConf 2016 - http://confreaks.tv/videos/elixirconf2016-string-theory
- "Reimplementing Ruby's Hash", Golden Gate Ruby Conference 2014 - http://confreaks.tv/videos/gogaruco2014-reimplementing-ruby-s-hash

Examples of my writing:

- "Elixir and IO Lists, Part 2: IO Lists in Phoenix" - http://nathanmlong.com/2016/11/elixir-and-io-lists-part-2-io-lists-in-phoenix/
- "Protect Your Data with PostgreSQL Constraints" - http://nathanmlong.com/2016/01/protect-your-data-with-postgresql-constraints/ - possibly the clearest and most complete explanation of this subject on the web

Specialties: Elixir, Phoenix, Ruby, and Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: At DockYard, I write performant, well-tested Elixir code for clients who value high-quality work.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked remotely with a team of Elixir engineers to build a recipe and kitchen appliance site.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Wrote code for this excellent Atlanta-based consultancy.

My colleagues said nice things about me. (Contact info available on request.)

- Phillip Gray, Software Developer: "Nathan's an excellent example of a developer who manages to balance deep knowledge with pragmatism around code, and it's great to have him as a more senior voice on the team... I think that Nathan might be one of the **most productive devs** I know."
- Jay Hayes, Software Developer: "Working with Nathan has been thrilling. He consistently comes through when **pairing on tough problems** and always has a gentle, pragmatic thought process that encourages good practice."
- Dan Ra, Project Strategist: "Nathan is constantly expressing a curiosity and inquisitiveness to figure out how best to implement features... Nathan is a **great teammate**: cooperative, supportive, and empowering."

While at BNR, I:

- Paired regularly to write clear, well-tested client code
- Refactored, optimized and improved core functionality of BNR's internal work-tracking app
- Wrote popular, in-depth blog posts on Elixir, Phoenix, and database consistency, as well as an internal summary of Elixir and Phoenix that CEO Aaron Hillegass singled out to the company as "truly great."

positions.title: Contract Software Developer, Jan 2016 - April 2016
positions.description: Worked remotely with my client's web development team, building out features and training junior developers. This was an intentionally short-term contract, which we wrapped up when my daughter was born. :)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked remotely with a small team of developers on service-oriented architecture for this popular European travel search site. Used Ruby, Rails and Sinatra.

- Enabled **better search results** with an algorithm to efficiently and lazily find the cheapest combinations of tickets for a multi-leg journey
- Built an extremely reliable **currency-conversion service** and client, with local caching for very fast lookup
- Helped rewrite the hypermedia client library our apps used for communication
- Helped to split one of our larger services into two

positions.title: Technical Manager
positions.description:
Contracted for the most popular Google Chrome extension (20 million users) to help the owner rework his business and development process.

- Migrated the team from Subversion to Git and separated public issue reports from private planning and prioritization
- Mentored distributed programmers and reviewed their code contributions
- Helped with business planning

positions.title: Web developer
positions.description: Programming in Ruby and Ruby on Rails, making heavy use of Javascript, including AJAX and the jQuery library.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Web developer working primarily with PHP.

positions.title: Web Developer and Tech Support
positions.description:
At Vision Wireless, I created a company intranet from scratch that most employees depend on every day. It includes training and reference materials, communication tools, and a customizable phone directory.

The technology behind it is an open-source stack: Apache, MySQL, and PHP, all of which I installed on the server myself. I also used Javascript and the jQuery library, including its AJAX functions, to make the site faster and more responsive.

positions.title: Freelance public relations writer
positions.description: Crafted newspaper and advertising copy to highlight the achievements and special projects of a Forsyth County home-building company. Interviewed satisfied customers and wrote about their experience with the company from start to finish, including all the things that made their house special.

positions.title: Freelance features writer
positions.description: Features writing. Write articles on music, arts, and outdoor recreation based on interviews with participants and organizers.

positions.title: Reporter/Photographer
positions.description:
*  Covered government, education, police, health care, business, science and wrote various human interest stories for this twice-a-week newspaper
* Proofread articles before publication, correcting for accuracy, clarity and style.
* Won Georgia Press Assocation's 1st Place Award for Spot News Photography (Division E) in 2005 for my photograph of a fugitive being captured at gunpoint.

positions.title: Editorial Assistant
positions.description:
*  Worked for University of Georgia public relations arm - profiled the work of UGA alumni in many fields - NASA scientists, artists, teachers, and a submarine builder,for example.
* Collected and edited material for regular magazine sections.
